newsitem.title: USA: MedPartners unit in European drug program.
newsitem.headline: MedPartners unit in European drug program.

text.p: Caremark International, a unit of MedPartners Inc, said Tuesday it will launch the first prescription benefit management program in Europe in an agreement with a Dutch insurance firm.

Caremark will provide mail service distribution of prescription drugs to 2.5 million people in the Netherlands covered by Zilveren Kruis Groep, said MedPartners. Zilveren Kruis and its four insurance affiliates are the largest health care insurance company in the Netherlands .
Caremark posted international revenues of $75 million in 1995. MedPartners could not be reached to determine the effect of the latest agreement on annual revenues.
